title: Chapter 308 Someone Comes Out
content:
Chapter 308 Someone Comes Out

breakthrough?

Xiao Luo thought of Lu Xue's strength when he fought against the archer woman.

Speaking of which, that woman with bow and arrow is definitely not weak.

Outside, he must be a famous genius.

But even at the Immortal Emperor Realm, the opponent was still defeated and even killed in the face of Lu Xue.

Lu Xuecai is the Immortal Lord Realm.

If Lu Xue breaks through to the Immortal Saint Realm, her combat power will probably be even more terrifying.

Thinking of this, Xiao Luo suddenly felt a little excited and said, "Sister Xue, are you going to break through?"

Lu Xue nodded slightly.

"If you have good luck, you should be able to break through."

Good luck...

should...

No, Sister Xue is a person with destiny. Can a person with destiny be unlucky? That's definitely OK.

A hint of confidence that should not belong to Xiao Luo came to my heart, making Qin Feng, who was standing by, confused.

Sister Xue is about to break through, so why are you confident?

At this time, Lu Xue looked directly into the depths of the corridor, and it was still pitch black inside.

The decadent aura of time continues to come, making people feel a sense of fear unconsciously.

"Let's go."

Immediately, the three men and one dragon stopped hesitating and rushed directly into the depths of the corridor.

At the same time, a figure suddenly appeared outside the bronze palace, silently staring at the huge palace in front of him.

.........

"Hahaha, everyone, don't be fine."

A dazzling light of fire broke through the sky and illuminated the entire sky.

The next moment, Li Changqing, the master of Huoyun Peak of Tiandi Academy, appeared outside the ancient battlefield, and a terrifying aura of the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm continued to emerge.

The blazing breath burned everyone present.

When they saw Li Changqing, the strong men of the four clans frowned slightly.

The first person who smelled the smell was indeed Tiandi Academy.

"You guys hide it so deeply."

Li Changqing looked at the ancient battlefield that was still expanding at this moment, and then sighed slightly.

If it weren't for the ancient battlefield such a change, I'm afraid the forces in the immortal world would not know where the ancient battlefield were.

"Master Li Feng, you haven't seen each other for many years, you are still so free and easy."

Xiao Mo, the leader of the Xiao clan, looked at Li Changqing in the void and then smiled faintly.

The other three tribes also looked at Li Changqing and said hello.

The four ancient tribes have never had any hostility towards the Tiandi Academy.

This was the case before, but it is still the case now.

But I can't say it in the future.

Looking at the four ancient tribes below, Li Changqing fell down directly.

"I don't hide it anymore. This time I came here to let some little guys from the academy go in and experience it."

"Everyone, you won't disagree, do you?"

Li Changqing looked at everyone and said with a smile.

There was a bit of threat in his words.

Hearing this, except Xiao Mo, the rest couldn't help but frown slightly.

From ancient times to the present, the ancient battlefield has been the unique resource of their four ancient tribes. Now they are giving it to others like this, and they are really reluctant to let it go.

Only Xiao Mo could see the reality clearly at a glance.

If you still want to enjoy the ancient battlefield alone, it is basically no longer possible.

The best proof is that the four adults have already hidden in the dark.

After all, no matter how strong their four ancient tribes are, they cannot be enemies of the entire fairyland.

"Master Li Feng, what happened in the ancient battlefield now is probably very clear. I am afraid that your students will encounter unexpected problems after entering."

Xiao Mo said with a sarcastic smile.

Hearing this, Li Changqing laughed, "You don't have to worry about this. I believe these little guys will be able to escape danger."

Immediately, Li Changqing waved his hand directly.

More than a dozen figures appeared in front of Li Changqing without warning.

Obviously, Li Changqing has a magic weapon for space.

The leader is Tang Hao, the eighteenth place in the Monster List.

The aura of the third level of the Immortal Emperor Realm is particularly obvious from this moment.

"The third level of the Immortal Emperor Realm, no wonder you are so confident."

Looking at Tang Hao with calm eyes in the crowd, Xiao Mo chuckled, as if he was muttering to himself, and as if he was announcing everyone present.

The rest of the people were also extremely shocked when they heard about it.

Tang Hao was still in the second level a few years ago, but now he is in the third level.

You should know that every level of cultivation in the Immortal Emperor Realm is extremely difficult. Some people need tens of thousands of years of accumulation, even hundreds of thousands or millions of years to be promoted to the first level.

And Tang Hao only took it for a few years.

For a moment, everyone's eyes at Tang Hao changed unconsciously.

This son has the top ten talents in the monster list!

As for the academy students beside Tang Hao, they were even more shocked.

Their eyes at Tang Hao were shocked, jealous, and incredible, but the most was the feeling of powerlessness that came from the deepest part of their hearts.

They could not catch up with Tang Hao's pace even if they rush forward.

More importantly, Tang Hao is only ranked 18th on the Monster List.

What kind of existence will the top ten be?

At this time, Tang Hao, who was regarded as the focus, had a expressionless face and a cold expression. His eyes were always looking at the direction of the ancient battlefield, and a surging fighting spirit in the depths of his eyes kept erupting.

At this moment, he was not pretending.

Because he could feel the terrifying sense of oppression coming from the ancient battlefield at this moment.

This made him feel a little excited.

At this moment, he had already secretly swore in his heart that in the near future, he would definitely conquer the entire ancient battlefield.

And his name will also resound throughout the entire fairy world.

Buzz —

At this moment, the ancient battlefield in the distance came again.

Everyone looked in the sound and saw the space trembling slightly.

The next moment, three young men covered in blood and a weak breath ran out in a embarrassed pace.

"Great Elder, save, help!"

The young man in the lead had a miserable face, and half of his face had rotted.

The other two are not much better, either missing or having few legs.

Seeing this, the powerful Ye tribe looked shocked.

"Ye Hun, what have you encountered?!"

The elder of the Ye clan hurried forward and used his strength to hold back the bodies of the three of them who were about to fall, and quickly fed a healing pill for each of them.

But even so, the aura of the three of them was still so weak.

Seeing this, everyone looked at the direction of the ancient battlefield and became solemn.

After a while, the Ye tribe named Ye Hun finally recovered some strength and barely opened their eyes.

"Ye Hun, what's going on? Where is Ye Tian?"

Hearing this, Ye Hun said weakly: "There has been a huge change in the ancient battlefield, and we are separated from Brother Ye Tian and the others."

"There is no way, we can only find a way to leave the ancient battlefield."

"But what we didn't expect was that we finally left the depths of the ancient battlefield. We thought it was safe, but we found that even the periphery of the ancient battlefield had become violent."

"Because of carelessness, we were attacked by a violent force that had just woken up."

Hearing this, everyone present was shocked.

The periphery of the ancient battlefield can be regarded as the safest place in the ancient battlefield, but now, is even the periphery of the ancient battlefield so dangerous?

No wonder there are still very few people coming out so far.
